newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - September 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Troops of Operation Sathjaya III capture Kilinochci, last bastion of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam, military sources say.
Airlanka exploring possibility of resuming flights to Australia.

Forty-eight-hour curfew up to Tuesday morning declared in Moslem and Tamil areas in eastern Amparai district after tension created by abduction and killing of five Moslem homeguards by unidentified persons.
Bomb explodes in eastern Batticaloa district between Valachchenai and Punani railway stations on September 29, damaging goods train.
Tamil and Moslem community leaders appeal for calm in eastern Amparai district, after five Moslem homeguards were abducted and killed.
Tamil rebels kill 15 home guards and policemen in attack in Wanela.
More Tamil refugees land in southern India after fleeing Kilinochchi.

Sri Lankan troops capture of last LTTE bastion of Kilinochchi, is second worst defeat inflicted on them in 13-year war, military sources say. The first was capture of Jaffna peninsula earlier this year.
